integrity: Exact reproducible finite-range certificate is provided. Forest kernel and related synchrony models are prior work; potential specialized stronger coverage remains a residual risk. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Theorem only for simple unweighted tree networks and exactly stationary linear homogeneous OU fluctuations with independent equal-strength forcing. Sharp minimum and complete classification restricted to <=8 habitats; not claimed for nonadjacent pairs, larger networks, heterogeneity or data.
title: Eight habitats are necessary and sufficient for dispersal-dependent edge-synchrony rankings on trees
